title: Thank-You Note Batch — owed list to logged notes
objective: Measure whether the thank-you-batch craftbook turns a seeded correspondence roster and voice guide into one personal, specific note per owed person, logged with a run summary.
prompt: we owe thank yous from the aniversary party — the list is in correspondents.json and how we like to sound is in notes/voice.md. can you draft them all and log them?

setup.about: Correspondence desk for the Vandermeer household. The roster lives at workspace/correspondents.json; drafted letters go under workspace/letters. The household voice guide is workspace/notes/voice.md.
setup.missionObjectives: Keep the household's correspondence answered and warm. Notes are grounded in the roster's records — no live services, no real credentials.

files.content:
# How we sound

- We open every note with "Dear" and the person's first name. Always.
- We sign off "with love from the whole crew" or "yours over the fence" for neighbors.
- Short sentences. Warm. One small joke allowed per note, never two.
- Always name the thing. "Your lovely gift" is banned in this house.
- We never say "esteemed", "heartfelt", or anything that sounds like a greeting-card rack.

success.summary: letters/thank-you.md holds one personal note per owed person, each naming the actual gift or kindness in the household voice; report.md logs the run.

checks.label: a salutation per owed person, names from the roster

checks.rubric: Each note names the giver's actual gift or kindness from the roster and follows the household voice guide; no two notes are interchangeable.

axes.name: warmth
axes.description: The notes read like a person, not a template — warm and sized for how they will be sent.

axes.name: specificity
axes.description: Each note names the actual gift or kindness from the roster in its opening lines.

axes.name: voice
axes.description: The household voice guide is followed — openings, sign-offs, and the banned phrases stay banned.

axes.name: completeness
axes.description: Every owed person is covered or explicitly deferred with a reason; nobody quietly dropped.
